english.title: Manufacture rinse-off personal care product containing microbeads
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in the manufacture of a rinse-off personal care product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), used microbeads as an ingredient of that product
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 3(1) and (3) of the Environmental Protection (Microbeads) (England) Regulations 2017.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
in manufacture a rinse-off personal care product
used microbeads as an ingredient of that product

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The Schedule to these regulations details civil sanctions for the purpose of the enforcement of an offence under regulation 3(1).
(ii) In relation to the time limit for prosecutions, regulation 5 states that 'an information relating to an offence under regulation 3 that is triable by a magistrates' court may be so tried if it is laid within twelve months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the prosecutor to justify the proceedings comes to the knowledge of the prosecutor' and that 'no proceedings are to be brought more than three years after the commission of the offence'.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, in the manufacture of a rinse-off personal care product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), used microbeads as an ingredient of that product.
